title: Nugget Medieval
description: A Medieval Modpack for exploration and combat
body:
Your set in a medieval realm your job is to survive and adventure the lands start a humble town hire workers forge an army! build castles and towers to defend your lands! conquer enemy castles siege war against your enemy's!

**Features:**
-  Medieval armor
-  Cosmetics for your armor
-  Medieval Weapons
-  Siege Machinery
-  Villager workers and recruits
-  Vast world terrain to explore
-  Plenty of foods to harvest and cook
-  New villages and castles
-  Backpacks to hold your stores
-  New block variants!
